answer: Each new identity must forge its key inside a secure enclave and present a hardware attestation that the key cannot be copied or moved, so the proof is a whisper only that one physical device can speak. A sybil farmer must buy one device per fake identity, while one honest member uses a phone they already own. Sharing or cloning is detected and the key revoked, so the cost of shale, silicon and hardware scales linearly with every fake while the reward per identity stays flat.
